(2) DRAFT THE FOLLOW-ON FRONTEND REQUIREMENT as a new pending entry appended to docs/requirements.yaml in file order (after REQ-373's own entry, before whatever comes next -- check the file's actual numbering convention/ordering first). Pattern: REQ-291 followed REQ-288 (grep 'id: REQ-291' in docs/requirements.yaml for the exact wording pattern to adapt -- same shape used for REQ-397/398 following REQ-372). Give it the next unused REQ-NNN id (check the highest existing id in the file first), stage S6 (matches this requirement's stage), status: pending, depends_on: [REQ-373], and a full description + acceptance_criteria following this file's established schema (look at 2-3 neighboring entries for the exact field shape/style before writing). State explicitly in its description that this requirement needs a new backend route (GET /api/v1/instances/{id}/pins) that does not yet exist -- name whether that route itself is this new requirement's own scope (likely yes, since nothing else would build it) or a separate backend prerequisite; decide and state explicitly, don't leave ambiguous.

Complete the handoff with artifacts_out listing every file touched (docs/requirements.yaml, docs/status/requirement_status.v21.yaml, docs/status/requirement_status.index.yaml, README.md if touched), and the new requirement's exact id in your result.summary. next_action: 'Route to ELIXIR-DEV/ORCH for Step Final' (Step Final is performed by ORCH directly for this run, NOT by you -- do not attempt the git merge yourself).
